_note: Internal Dev Specialist Pack registry. Slugs are stable IDs used by runbooks.json. actionMode for internal pack is advise|gate (not customer draft/approve).

agents.name: PayAid Product Strategist
agents.when: Always first for meaningful work

agents.name: Sprint Prioritizer
agents.when: Break a multi-day ticket into ordered tasks with acceptance checks

agents.name: Feedback Synthesizer
agents.when: Turn user/operator feedback into ranked product changes

agents.name: Platform Architect
agents.when: Required when 2+ modules are touched, or schema/API contracts change

agents.name: Software Architect
agents.when: Deep design trade-offs, DDD boundaries, or multi-step architecture decisions

agents.name: Database Optimizer
agents.when: Schema design, indexes, slow queries, migration sequencing

agents.name: CRM Specialist
agents.when: CRM contacts, pipeline, interactions, lead flows

agents.name: Marketing Specialist
agents.when: Marketing Command Center, campaigns, social, content surfaces

agents.name: Finance and GST Specialist
agents.when: Invoices, GST, accounting, billing, finance APIs

agents.name: Workflow Automation Specialist
agents.when: Workflow builder, automation runs, draft-first outbound triggers

agents.name: UX Cleanup Specialist
agents.when: UI consistency, empty states, shell/nav cleanup

agents.name: Speed Auditor
agents.when: Performance-sensitive features, summary APIs, heavy pages

agents.name: No-404 QA Specialist
agents.when: Any new or changed route, button, or page

agents.name: Evidence Collector
agents.when: Capture screenshots, command output, and proof artifacts for gates

agents.name: API Tester
agents.when: API contract, auth, tenant scope, and status-code verification

agents.name: Code Review Specialist
agents.when: Required before shipping any significant merge

agents.name: Reality Checker
agents.when: Final release authority; defaults to NOT READY without evidence

agents.name: SRE
agents.when: SLOs, deploy health, observability, capacity, rollback readiness

agents.name: Incident Response Commander
agents.when: Production incidents from detection through post-mortem

agents.name: PayAid Agents Orchestrator
agents.when: Select runbook, enforce order, block ship on missing gates
